description: Use this only when the user explicitly asks to test an SMTP login for a mail account they control and provides its credentials. Connects to the SMTP server and reports whether connection, encryption and authentication succeed. If from_email and to_email are both given, it also sends one test email. Credentials are not stored.

encryption.description: The encryption protocol: ssl, tls, or none

from_email.description: Optional sender email address for sending a test email

host.description: The SMTP server hostname, e.g. smtp.gmail.com

password.description: The SMTP password or app-specific password

port.description: The SMTP port number, e.g. 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL, 25 for unencrypted

to_email.description: Optional recipient email address for sending a test email

name: smtp_check
title: SMTP Check
